About this study

All five neighbors use the shared walking and visit controls. Taller changes the original neighbor’s scale; the blue blouse changes hair and clothing. The yukata has a separate continuous cloth layer over the moving legs. The child has shorter legs, a larger head relative to the body, and a raised seat; the doorway opens automatically for them. Inside meal and Counter meal show the selected person from opposite sides. Seating uses the shared settling motion; a full climb onto the child’s raised seat is still a separate animation task. This remains an animation study on the existing street. New background artwork is deferred.
